notes:
## New
- Audio Reader is far more accurate. The new Precise engine (built in, nothing to install) catches each key press and release to within a few milliseconds and stops picking up random extra notes.
- Trim in Audio Reader and MIDI Converter: cut out intros or any part (From / to, then Cut). Cut as many parts as you like, Listen to check, Undo or Clear any time before saving.
- Visualizer previews in Audio Reader, MIDI Converter and Synthesia Reader (step 6): falling notes and QWERTY keys. Pick Both, QWERTY only or Synthesia only.
- Songs tab Play and every Listen now have a choice: GNP Window (plays inside GN Pianist with its own piano sound, no countdown) or Other Window (types into your piano window like before). Play turns into pause, the square stops.
- Settings > Sound & Visualizer: Sustain and Velocity for GN Pianist's piano sound (and your piano window if you tick it), plus your own visualizer colours.
- Audio Reader Save: save as a MIDI file, or as a Song straight into your Song List.
- Drag the timeline while stopped to look through a song. Listen starts from there.

## Improved
- Audio Reader clean-up removes echo notes, stray clicks and buried background notes, and can line up chords so sheets show clean [chords].
- New tab order: Instructions, Sheet Library, Folders, Songs, Manual, Synthesia Reader, Audio Reader, MIDI Converter, MIDI Connect, Instruments.
- Instructions and the guided tour cover all of the above.

Note: this update is a bigger download than usual because the new note model is built in.

More info: https://deusaux.github.io
